entities.name: Query protein Q700X4
observations: The 287-residue query sequence is an exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt Q700X4 from Sphingobium herbicidovorans.
The protein belongs to the TauD family; Pfam TauD domain spans residues 7–271.
The enzyme requires Fe and L-ascorbate cofactors according to the curated reference annotation.

entities.name: S-dichlorprop oxidative ether cleavage
observations: This is an Fe(II)/2-oxoglutarate-dependent dioxygenase reaction that cleaves the substrate aryl-alkyl ether bond.

entities.name: S-mecoprop oxidative ether cleavage
observations: The enzyme also accepts related phenoxypropionate and phenoxyacetate herbicide substrates, but exact substrate breadth is narrower than the core assignment.

entities.name: 2,4-D oxidative ether cleavage
observations: This is reported as an additional accepted phenoxyacetate substrate for homologous enzyme annotations; the exact activity for every substrate is not independently established by sequence alone.
